main_body: palm tree (crown of fronds above segmented trunk)
top_band: upper crown surface of palm fronds in bright/mid greens across rows 1-11
evidence: Walking down the center column of the trunk/crown: rows 1-11 show the top/arch of the palm crown (lightest highlight at row 5), overlapping and casting a dark brown shadow onto the recessed trunk face starting at row 12 down to row 39.

style.evidence: The candidate uses 5 green steps and 5 brown steps with dark material outlines (dark green around fronds, dark brown around trunk), avoiding flat fills via trunk rings and frond ribs. However, compared to the Beodeul reference trees—which have intricate, varied root flare, broken organic silhouettes, and complex leaf cluster dithering—the palm has a repetitive, mechanical horizontal-band trunk and a flat, cut-off base (row 39-40), making it look stiffer and more sticker-like.
